verdict.rationale: Glama is a SaaS platform (chat, MCP gateway, hosting) that handles user conversations, documents and call logs, so user-controlled data retention and deletion is a fair axis. The pack has no evidence of retention settings, deletion controls or data-expiry policies. The nearby items are adjacent only: gateway call logging, private-by-default listing visibility, saving and tagging chats, and the client-side Try-it panel not storing credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
